candidate_evaluation.candidate_order: the exact order declared in each family specification
candidate_evaluation.failed_candidate: record failure and stop the affected experiment; do not silently replace its configuration or inspect test data

hierarchy: training-weighted validation log loss, lower is better
simpler model or architecture if still tied
classification.threshold_selection: no optimization; threshold is frozen before training and test authorization
classification.tie_breaker_definition: RF: lower n_estimators, shallower max_depth (None is treated as most complex), larger min_samples_leaf, then lower max_features complexity; TGNN: lower hidden dimension, fewer layers, lower dropout, then earlier candidate index.

hierarchy: simpler model or architecture if still tied
regression.tie_breaker_definition: RF: use the RF simplicity order; TGNN: use the TGNN simplicity order; then earlier candidate index.

final_identity_freeze.freeze_event: After the four independent model-specific training gates accept their outputs and before any test target is opened.
final_identity_freeze.after_test_opening: No retuning, recalibration, feature change, architecture change, seed change, or model replacement.

selection_outputs: For each task, retain a complete candidate table with candidate index, configuration, seed, train/validation sizes, primary and secondary metrics, tie-break decisions, and immutable selected identity.
